name: AmplitudeMod
description: Amplitude follower with separate attack and release smoothing — extracts the envelope of the input as a control signal. Similar to Amplitude but exposes both rates of an asymmetric one-pole. From sc3-plugins BlackrainUGens.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Input signal whose amplitude is tracked

inputs.name: attackTime
inputs.description: Smoothing time when the envelope rises (seconds, -60dB convergence)

inputs.name: releaseTime
inputs.description: Smoothing time when the envelope falls (seconds, -60dB convergence)

name: BMoog
description: Moog-style ladder filter with selectable response mode and tanh-shaped saturation in the feedback path. Ports the classic 4-pole topology with smooth nonlinear self-resonance. From sc3-plugins BlackrainUGens.

inputs.name: q
inputs.description: Resonance amount (0 to 1) — values approaching 1 self-oscillate

inputs.name: saturation
inputs.description: Drive amount applied inside the feedback path before the tanh stage

name: IIRFilter
description: Direct-form 2nd-order resonant IIR filter (biquad) — single-input, single-output multi-pole filter useful as a lighter alternative to RLPF/RHPF when only one slope is needed. From sc3-plugins BlackrainUGens.

inputs.name: rq
inputs.description: Reciprocal of Q — bandwidth as a fraction of cutoff (smaller is narrower/more resonant)

name: SVF
description: Chamberlin state-variable filter with simultaneously-mixable lowpass / bandpass / highpass / notch / peak outputs. Each response is computed in parallel and summed by the corresponding mix gain — ideal for smooth morphs between filter types. From sc3-plugins BlackrainUGens.

inputs.name: res
inputs.description: Resonance amount (0 to 1) — values approaching 1 self-oscillate

inputs.name: lowpass
inputs.description: Mix gain for the low-pass response

inputs.name: bandpass
inputs.description: Mix gain for the band-pass response

inputs.name: highpass
inputs.description: Mix gain for the high-pass response

inputs.name: notch
inputs.description: Mix gain for the notch (band-reject) response

inputs.name: peak
inputs.description: Mix gain for the peak response
